blind.description: A stylized wooden bakery display stand or shop counter. It features a solid timber frame with corner posts serving as feet, a lower two-door cabinet with round knobs, two open shelves packed with baked goods (baguettes in woven baskets, glazed rolls, round buns, and pastries in wooden trays), and a countertop display. On the top counter rests a cluster of golden-brown scored artisan bread loaves draped over a red runner cloth, alongside a round frosted cake topped with dark berries and green leaves on a platter. The back panel is enclosed with planking and green inset panels.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden top with four to five round, golden-brown baked loaves resting on a red cloth on the left and center, and a round cream-frosted cake topped with dark berries on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 feet tall (roughly 60% of the 5 ft 9 in figure's height) and about 3.5 feet wide.
